summary: Crow's nest and log cabin in 1921, pole L-4 tower in 1933, abandoned 1958 and gone; a log cabin ruin a quarter mile east is the only remnant described.

facts.design: Crow's nest and log cabin (1921); pole L-4 tower (1933)
facts.status_note: Abandoned 1958 and gone per firelookout.com; the log cabin a quarter mile east is described as ruins, undated.

events.note: Crow's nest and a log cabin a quarter mile east, per firelookout.com

evidence.supports: about twelve miles east of Yaak
1921 crow's nest and log cabin a quarter mile east; cabin still there, ruins
evidence.quote: 1921: crows nest, log cabin 1/4 mile east (still there, ruins).

evidence.supports: listed under the Kootenai National Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The firelookout.com index record reads Standing, but the Boulder Mtn. detail page says it was abandoned in 1958 and is Gone, and the FFLA list agrees. Gone is used; the Standing value looks like an index-scrape artifact.

notes_for_editor: Two sources agree the site is gone (firelookout.com detail page and FFLA list). The 1921 / 1933 / 1958 timeline rests on one firelookout.com line; no other source dates it. The cabin ruin's date is not stated. Elevation 7058 ft equals 2151.3 m, which matches the record. The record's source entry for firelookout.com carries status Standing and elevation 2151.28 m; the detail page text is the one used. The 1921 crow's nest and cabin are written as built events; the page does not say the cabin was built in 1921 specifically, only that both appear in that year's entry, so the cabin date is the page's own. No photos, staffing or fire events found. Montana Lookouts gives only a survey location (35N-30W-2) and no history. Two web searches returned only the same pages.
